newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China CPI up 6.4 pct yr/yr in 1997.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China CPI up 6.4 pct yr/yr in 1997.

text.p: China's consumer price inflation (CPI) is expected to rise by 6.4 percent year-on-year in 1997, the China Market Economic News said on Tuesday.
China's benchmark retail price inflation is expected to rise by 4.0 percent year-on-year in 1997, the newspaper said.
The forecast has taken into account possible price hikes by the government in the second half of the year, it said.
Retail price inflation was expected to rise by 2.0 percent year-on-year in the first half, while consumer price inflation was expected to go up by 4.4 percent, it said.
China has set a target of 6.0 percent for retail price inflation this year, down from an actual rise of 6.1 percent in 1996.
China's retail price inflation rose by 2.0 percent in the first five months, consumer price inflation rose by 4.3 percent.
